paper_verdict.estimator_family: other (static panel PCSE/FGLS with AR(1); no FE, IV or dynamic terms)
paper_verdict.pooling_concerns: Outcome is log GDP per capita level (text calls it growth); ICT variables mix logs and levels (IUI, IRPTR unlogged), so log-log elasticities and level-log semi-elasticities are not comparable; FBPH/MBP appear as large counts not rates; I(1) variables with no cointegration (spurious regression risk, R-squared near 1); no N printed and stated '1000 observations' is inconsistent with 10 economies x 26 years; 2-economy subsamples; several variable labels are wrong in the text; same data feed overlapping estimates (model 4 PCSE and FGLS).
